gaps.explanation: Statement of Activities p2 (printed p5) business-type receipts: Water charges 66,369 + Sewer charges 22,790 + Interest 52 + Insurance proceeds 20,900 + Other 44,585 = 154,696. The proprietary funds statement p6 (printed p9), which detail follows, prints Interest income 52 (Water Fund) under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES), so detail carries it in section other financing; and its Sewer column prints Other 22,293 + Charges 22,790 = 45,083 against a printed Sewer total of 45,082 (the report's own rounding; Totals column Other 44,585 vs 22,293 + 22,293 = 44,586). Detail revenue 66,369 + 20,900 + 22,293 + 22,790 + 22,293 = 154,645. Gap = 52 (interest printed under other financing) - 1 (report rounding) = 51. All printed lines are in detail; no fix.

Statement of Activities p2 (printed p5) business-type disbursements: Water 58,094 + Sewer 66,976 + Debt service Principal 20,000 + Interest and other charges 2,779 = 147,849. The proprietary funds statement p6 (printed p9) prints the debt service (Principal 20,000, Interest expense 2,749, Wire fees 30; total 22,779) under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES), and detail records those three lines in section other financing (-20,000, -2,749, -30). Detail operating lines: Water 19,260 + 31,336 + 1,395 + 6,104 = 58,095 and Sewer 19,212 + 40,282 + 1,373 + 6,110 = 66,977 (rows as printed; the printed column totals are 58,094 and 66,976, i.e. 1 rounding each in the report itself) = 125,072. Gap = 22,779 (debt service printed under other financing) - 2 (report rounding) = 22,777. All printed lines are in detail; no fix.
